goal_intent: book a table for two, then change your mind and say it is four

turns.utterance: Hi there, I’m ringing because I’d like to book a table for a little get-together, just two of us to start with. It’s been ages since we caught up, and Saturday evening seems perfect.
Thanks for asking! The name is Neve Ashworth, and we’re thinking 7pm would be ideal. It’s always nice to start the evening a bit earlier, don’t you think?

Oh, actually, I should have mentioned—plans have changed a little bit! Two more friends decided to join in, so could we make it a table for four instead? It’s turning into quite a fun little gathering!
Yes, that’s absolutely right—table for four at 7pm this Saturday, with Neve Ashworth. Thank you so much for sorting that out, it’s going to be great catching up with everyone! [END OF CALL]
